__fixture.note: §4.3 — requires_mapping is the honest half of every integration. No external system knows our employee_number, so an unmapped identifier is a 400 with details.unmapped[] rather than a file with blanks in the identifier column. A payroll file with a missing employee id is WORSE than no file: it fails silently downstream, in someone else's system, after money moved.
